t: Mistake In Translation Of An Article Entitled Kingpo Residents And Fu Sico-En

pages.en:
F.M. 2
G. 59M-1 30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S. 5, Special Branch, XXXXX,
REPORT
Date October 24, 19 38.
Subject Mistake in translation of an article entitled 'Ningpo
Residents and Fu Siao-en".
Made by C.A. Loh Sih-kya. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached file, I regret to say
that Clerk King Hsin-kuo had made an incorrect translation.
Evidently, in the hurry of his work, he took it for granted,
upon reading the characters 寧波旅滬同鄉 ("Ningpo Li Hu Dong
Shang") that the Ningpo Fellow Provincial's Association was
meant, forgetting that the character "Lei" (旅) was not used.
A correct translation of the phrase would have been "Ningpo
fellow countrymen residing in Shanghai".

As the mistake has had such grave consequences and
as I am responsible for translations, I beg to express my
sincere regret and to submit myself for any disciplinary
action you think fit.

Loh Sih Kya
Clerical Assistant.

D. C. (Special Branch).

85
Noted. Pass
to Sr. Branch Registry
to FILE
[Signature]
DEPUTY COMMISSIONER
(SPECIAL BRANCH)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号............
S. 5，特务科，XXXXX，
报告
日期：1938年10月24日。
事由：关于题为《宁波旅沪同乡与傅筱庵》一文的翻译错误。
由罗思嘉（C.A. Loh Sih-kya）呈报。转呈人 [签名]

关于附件档案，我很遗憾地指出，书记员金新国（King Hsin-kuo）的翻译有误。显然，由于工作匆忙，他在看到“寧波旅滬同鄉”（Ningpo Li Hu Dong Shang）这几个字时，想当然地认为是指“宁波同乡会”，却忘记了原文中并未使用“会”字。该短语的正确译法应为“旅居上海的宁波同乡”。

鉴于此错误造成了如此严重的后果，且我负责翻译工作，我谨表示诚挚的歉意，并愿意接受您认为合适的任何纪律处分。

罗思嘉（Loh Sih Kya）
助理书记员。

副 commissioner （特务科）。

THIS NUMBER....................................................
AND DO NOT DEAL WITH MORE THAN
ONE MATTER IN THE SAME LETTER

CONFIDENTIAL.

Council Chamber.

ADMINISTRATION BUILDING.

Shanghai........21st October,........1938..

Major K. M. Bourne,
Commissioner of Police.

My dear Bourne,

With reference to your note of the 19th October
on the subject of the alleged propaganda against Fu Hsiao-
En conducted by the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association,
I enclose a translation of the article in question which
has been made by Mr. Kliene.

It would appear that the Police translation of
the article is not quite correct. The Police translation
definitely quotes the "Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Associa-
tion", whereas a correct translation would appear to be
"People in various walks of life, especially the Ningpo
residents".

Under these circumstances I do not think we
would have any justification for approaching Mr. Yu Ya
Ching as you suggest.

Mr. T. K. Ho assures me that Mr. Kliene's
translation is correct.

I return all the papers.

Yours sincerely,

（签名）

Encls.
DB.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 21 OCT. 1933）

上海........1938年10月21日..

K. M. Bourne 少校，
警务处处长。

亲爱的 Bourne：

关于你10月19日就所谓宁波同乡会对傅筱庵（Fu Hsiao-En）进行宣传指控一事所发的便函，现附上由 Kliene 先生制作的有关文章的译文。

看来警方对该文章的翻译并不完全正确。警方的译文明确引用了“宁波同乡会”，而正确的译文似乎是“各界人士，尤其是宁波居民”。

在这种情况下，我认为我们没有理由按照你的建议去接触虞洽卿（Yu Ya Ching）先生。

何德奎（T. K. Ho）先生向我保证，Kliene 先生的译文是正确的。

现将所有文件退回。

此致，

（签名）

附件。

pages.en:
Transition of cutting from the
"Hwa Mei Chen Pao", 18th October, 1938.

Fu Hsio-en employs shameless tricks
to curry favour with the Japanese;
Dancing partners induced to pose as
"Girls of good families";
Managers of Vienna Dance Hall bribed;
Twenty-five dancing girls take part in
"Ceremony".

When Fu Hsio-en recently accepted the new post to
serve as the "puppet", many scenes of utmost shamelessness
were enacted. Our contempt for the man cannot but be greatly
increased with the exposure of these scandals. For instance,
on the day of his inauguration, he spent a large sum of money
to engage twenty-five dancing partners from the Vienna Dance
Hall to pose as "virtuous girls of Shanghai" to curry favour
with the Japanese, and to show his popularity with the local
community. These twenty-five pretty and coquettish "damsels"
were employed to adorn the ceremony and to fawn on Fu's
Japanese masters; but as a matter of fact they only proved
the traitor Fu to be a man utterly void of shame.

The arrangement for the affair was made by Fu's
foster son, a certain Zi, who gave $250 to each of the two
managers of the Vienna Dance Hall, Zao and Tsang. They then
induced twenty-five dancing girls to participate in the
ceremony with the promise of a reward of $40 each.

1
pages.zh:
摘自1938年10月18日《华美晨报》剪报的译文。

傅筱庵施展无耻伎俩
讨好日本人；
诱使舞女假扮
“良家女子”；
贿赂维也纳舞厅经理；
二十五名舞女参加
“典礼”。

傅筱庵最近接受新职充当“傀儡”时，上演了许多极其无耻的场面。随着这些丑闻的曝光，我们对这个人的蔑视不禁大大增加。例如，在他就职当天，他花费巨资从维也纳舞厅雇佣了二十五名舞伴，假扮成“上海良家女子”以讨好日本人，并向当地社区展示其受欢迎程度。这二十五位妖艳迷人的“少女”被用来装点门面，向傅的日本主子献媚；但事实上，她们只证明了叛徒傅是一个毫无羞耻之心的人。

此事由傅的养子某氏（Zi）安排，他给予维也纳舞厅的两名经理赵（Zao）和曾（Tsang）每人250美元。随后，他们以每人40美元的报酬为诱饵，引诱二十五名舞女参加典礼。

1

pages.en:
The girls, however, did not care about the money; for
in spite of their profession they do not lack patriotism. When
the affair was over, they expressed regret at having been
beguiled into acting disreputably before the enemy. Some of
them rejected the reward, and even reproached Zhao and Liang
about their avarice and baseness.
On the morning of the day before yesterday, when the
newly-appointed puppet mayor, Fu Hsiao-en, figured in the
comedy by assuming office at the Civic Centre, someone, with
a forged pass, went to watch the proceedings. On his return
this person related that the whole affair was exactly like
a puppet show, and ludicrous. He saw Liang Hung-tsz, an
Tsung-yao, Fu Hsiao-en and a few Japanese take part by turns
in the absurd performance. The ceremony took place in the
Auditorium of the former City Government building. There were
over 30 shell holes in the north-east corner of the building.
The radio room, telephone room and electricity room on the
fourth floor had been completely destroyed, and the glass
shattered and floors in the library and the museum entirely
burnt. Not a book remained in the library where the wooden
bookshelves were destroyed by fire. Only the steel part of
the library was intact. As for the damage, a building contractor
has undertaken to make repairs at the cost of $200,000. The
work will be completed in two months. The bogus city government
is now carrying out its office work in the library. Only the
Headquarters of the Police Guard have been removed with the
city government to the Civic Centre; the various Bureaux
have not yet been installed.

2
pages.zh:
然而，这些女孩并不在乎钱；因为尽管身处风尘，她们并不缺乏爱国心。事后，她们对被骗在敌人面前做出有辱人格的行为表示后悔。其中一些人拒绝了报酬，甚至斥责赵和梁（Liang）的贪婪和卑鄙。
前天上午，新任傀儡市长傅筱庵在市中心举行就职喜剧表演时，有人持伪造通行证前往观看。此人回来后讲述说，整个事件简直像一场木偶戏，滑稽可笑。他看到梁鸿志（Liang Hung-tsz）、孙传芳（Sun Tsung-yao，原文拼写可能有误，通常指孙传芳或类似人物，此处依音译保留或修正为常见历史人物，但根据上下文及后文Sun Sung-yao，此处暂按原文音译或对应历史人物，注：历史上参与伪政权者有梁鸿志等，孙传芳已死，此处可能是孙曜东或其他人，原文为An Tsung-yao，疑为OCR错误，结合后文Sun Sung-yao，此处译为安宗耀（音译）或保留原文逻辑，鉴于后文出现Sun Sung-yao，此处前文为An Tsung-yao，故译为安宗耀（音译））、傅筱庵和几名日本人轮流参与了这场荒谬的表演。典礼在原市政府大楼的礼堂举行。大楼东北角有30多个弹孔。四楼的无线电室、电话室和电力室已被彻底摧毁，图书馆和博物馆的玻璃破碎，地板全部烧毁。图书馆内木制书架被火焚毁，书籍无存。只有图书馆的钢结构部分完好无损。至于损坏情况，一名建筑承包商已承诺以20万美元的费用进行修复。工程将在两个月内完成。伪市政府现在在图书馆内办公。只有警察总队总部随市政府迁至市中心；各局尚未入驻。

2

pages.en:
Ningpo Residents petition the
Ningpo Authorities to seal the
property of Fu Hsiao-en.

Fu Hsiao-en has unscrupulously joined the illegal
Government, and on the 16th inst assumed the Office of
"Mayor of Shanghai". People in various walks of life,
especially the Ningpo residents, are indignant over this
matter. Yesterday Zeng Ching-ming and thirty odd others
petitioned the Ningpo authorities to seal Fu's property
in Chihai as a warning to traitors.

Fu was first engaged as a foreman in Jiang Seng
Iron Works, Pootung, and later he joined the China Merchants
Steamship Navigation Company as a low grade godown clerk.
As a result of his obsequiousness he very soon became the
favourite of Sheng Heng-seng and was promoted to a high
post in the Company. Later, he took charge of the Commercial
Bank of China and was elected Chairman of the former Chinese
Chamber of Commerce. Within a very short time he became a
prominent person. He might have become a great man were he
scrupulous or possessed any sense of self-respect; but he
forgot himself when carried away by success. Taking advantage
of his position and authority he perpetrated every variety of
unlawfulness. When the Nationalist Army commenced its expedition
to the North, he was in league with Sun Chuan-fang and he did
his utmost to frustrate the expedition. When the Shanghai-Woosung
district was occupied, the Nationalist Government issued a
warrant for his arrest. He fled to Dairen and there hid himself
under the protection of the Japanese.

3
pages.zh:
宁波居民 petition 宁波当局
查封傅筱庵财产。

傅筱庵肆无忌惮地加入非法政府，并于本月16日就任“上海市长”。各界人士，尤其是宁波居民，对此事感到愤怒。昨日，曾清明（Zeng Ching-ming）等三十余人向宁波当局请愿，要求查封傅在镇海（Chihai，即镇海）的财产，以警示叛徒。

傅最初在浦东江生铁厂（Jiang Seng Iron Works，音译）担任工头，后来进入招商局轮船公司担任低级仓库职员。由于他阿谀奉承，很快成为盛恒生（Sheng Heng-seng，音译，可能指盛宣怀家族成员或相关人物）的心腹，并在公司内晋升至高职位。后来，他掌管了中国商业银行业务，并当选为前上海总商会主席。在很短的时间内，他成为了一个显赫人物。如果他谨慎行事或拥有任何自尊心，本可能成为一位伟人；但他被成功冲昏了头脑，忘乎所以。他利用自己的地位和权力，犯下了各种违法行为。当国民革命军开始北伐时，他与孙传芳勾结，极力阻挠北伐。当沪淞地区被占领时，国民政府发布了逮捕他的通缉令。他逃往大连，在日本人的庇护下藏身。

3

pages.en:
In 1934 he returned to Shanghai, repented his evil-
doings and begged certain influential persons to arrange with
the Government for the cancellation of the warrant for his
arrest. He should be grateful for the Government's leniency;
but unexpectedly he has now treated marauders as his superiors
and on the 15th instant assumed the office of the Mayor of
Shanghai. This is a disgrace to his ancestors as well as to
his descendants, and we Ningpo residents also feel humiliated.
We, therefore, beg the Chinhai District Government to seal
up and confiscate Fu's property and to appropriate same for
the Anti-Aggression Fund.

Objection of Fu's son is False

It is reported that Ping-kuei, the son of Fu Hsiao-en,
did earnestly persuade his father not to accept the post of
Mayor but failed in the endeavour; for this reason he decided
to sever all connections with his father.
According to news reporters this information is incorrect.
Fu Hsiao-en is a crafty man. Fearing that his connection with
the illegal Government may detrimentally affect his sons and
grandsons, that his ancestral graves may be desecrated by his
fellow-provincials, and that his property may be confiscated,
he now throws dust in the eyes of the public by this piece of
false information. Ping-kuei frequently visits hardware shops
in Canton Road and the Kuei Wei Building.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL TRANSLATION OFFICE OCT 19 1938）

4
(Note: Received for translation late p.m. 19th October, 1938.)
C. Kliene
pages.zh:
1934年，他回到上海，忏悔自己的恶行，并恳求某些有影响力的人士与政府安排撤销对他的通缉令。他本应感激政府的宽恕；但出乎意料的是，他现在竟认贼作父，并于本月15日就任上海市长。这不仅辱没祖先，也祸及子孙，我们宁波居民也感到蒙羞。因此，我们恳请镇海区政府查封并没收傅的财产，并将其拨作抗日基金。

傅子之反对系虚假

据报道，傅筱庵之子平贵（Ping-kuei，音译）曾 earnestly 劝告其父不要接受市长职务，但未成功；因此他决定与父亲断绝一切关系。
据新闻记者称，此消息不实。傅筱庵是个狡猾的人。他担心与非法政府的联系可能会不利地影响其子孙，担心祖坟会被同乡毁坏，担心财产会被没收，因此现在用这条虚假信息来掩人耳目。平贵经常光顾广东路和桂巍大楼（Kuei Wei Building，音译）的五金店。

（印：上海公共租界工部局翻译处 1938年10月19日）

4
（注：1938年10月19日下午晚些时候收到用于翻译。）
C. Kliene

宁波居民请愿
要求宁波当局出售傅筱庵的财产。

傅筱庵无耻地加入非法政府，并于本月15日就任“上海市长”。各界人士，尤其是宁波居民，对此事感到愤慨。昨日，冷世清等三十余人向宁波当局请愿，要求出售傅在镇海的财产，以警示汉奸。

傅最初受雇于浦东同兴铁厂（Tootung Iron Works）担任工头，后来进入轮船招商局担任低级仓库职员。由于他阿谀奉承，很快成为盛恒生（音译）(Sheng Heng-seng) 的心腹，并在公司内晋升至高位。随后，他掌管了中国商业银行，并当选为前上海总商会会长。在很短的时间内，他便成为显赫人物。如果他行事谨慎或拥有任何自尊感，本可能成为一位伟人；但他在成功面前迷失了自我。他利用自己的地位和权势，犯下各种不法行为。当国民革命军开始北伐时，他与孙传芳勾结，并竭力阻挠北伐。当沪淞地区被占领后，国民政府发布了逮捕他的通缉令。他逃往大连，在日本人的庇护下藏匿。

3

pages.en:
In 1934 he returned to Shanghai, repented his evil-
doings and begged certain influential persons to arrange with
the Government for the cancellation of the warrant for his
arrest. He should be grateful for the Government's leniency;
but unexpectedly he has now accepted murder as his superiors
and on the 15th instant assume the office of the Mayor of
Shanghai. This is a disgrace to his ancestors as well as to
his descendants, and to Ningpo residents also feel humiliated.
We, therefore, beg the Chinnan District Government to seal
up and confiscate Fu's property and to appropriate same for
the Anti-Aggression Fund.

Objection of Fu's son is False

It is reported that Ping-Kuei, the son of Fu Hsiao-en,
did earnestly persuade his father not to accept the post of
Mayor but failed in the endeavour; for this reason he decided
to sever all connections with his father.
According to news reporters this information is incorrect.
Fu Hsiao-en is a crafty man. Fearing that his connection with
the illegal Government may detrimentally affect his sons and
grandsons, that his ancestral graves may be desecrated by his
fellow-provincials, and that his property may be confiscated,
he now throws dust in the eyes of the public by this piece of
false information. Ping-kuei frequently visits hardware shops
in Canton Road and the Kuei Wei Building.

4
(Note: Received for translation late p.m. 19th October, 1938.)
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL TRANSLATION OFFICE OCT 19 1938）
C. Klien
pages.zh:
1934年，他回到上海，对自己的恶行表示悔过，并恳求某些有影响力的人士与政府安排撤销对他的通缉令。他本应感激政府的宽恕；但出乎意料的是，他现在认贼作父，并于本月15日就任上海市长。这不仅辱没祖先和后代，也让宁波居民感到蒙羞。因此，我们恳请镇海县政府查封并没收傅的财产，并将其拨充救国基金。

傅之子的反对纯属虚假

据报道，傅筱庵之子傅品圭曾极力劝阻其父接受市长职务，但未成功；因此他决定与父亲断绝一切关系。
据新闻记者称，此消息不实。傅筱庵是个狡猾的人。因担心其与非法政府的关系会不利地影响其子孙，担心其祖坟会被同乡亵渎，以及担心其财产被没收，他现在通过散布这一虚假信息来迷惑公众。傅品圭经常光顾广东路和桂巍大楼（音译）(Kuei Wei Building) 的五金店。

4
（注：1938年10月19日晚收到翻译件。）
（印：上海公共租界工部局翻译处 1938年10月19日）
C. Klien

pages.en:
Date October 19, 1938.

(Special Branch) Office Notes
Commissioner.

Sir,

The press attack on Ju Siao-en, for which the Ningpo
Fellow Countrymen's Association is responsible, comes within
the category of inciting. While those responsible for
compilation of the article are not likely to risk their skins
outside the confines of an easy chair, the effect on
irresponsible youths seeking opportunity to demonstrate their
martyrs' spirit might be tragic.

I suggest the Association be informed that these press
attacks display on the part of its members a sad lack of
appreciation of the asylum they are afforded in the Settlement.

J.W. Robertson
D.C. (Special Branch)
pages.zh:
日期：1938年10月19日。

（特别支部）办公笔记
致警务处长。

先生，

由宁波同乡会负责的针对傅筱庵的新闻界攻击，属于煽动性质。虽然撰写该文章的责任人不太可能在舒适的扶手椅之外冒生命危险，但其对那些寻求机会展示烈士精神的轻率青年所产生的影响可能是悲剧性的。

我建议通知该同乡会，这些新闻攻击表明其成员严重缺乏对在租界内所获庇护的感激之情。

J.W. Robertson
副督察长（特别支部）

pages.en:
D.C. (Sp.Br.)

October 18, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

Hwa Mei Chen Pao :-

NINGPO RESIDENTS AND FU SIAO-EN

The assumption of the post of Mayor
of the Shanghai Special City Government by Fu Siao-en
(傅筱庵) on October 16 was a ridiculous comedy. For
instance, on the day of his assumption, with a view to
gaining the confidence of the Japanese and demonstrating
his influence, he secured 25 dancing girls from the
Vienne Dance Hall (維也納), whom he introduced to the
Japanese as well known girls and ladies of Shanghai. It
is said that this was brought about by his adopted son
Hsu (徐) who, on his behalf, had approached one Chao
(趙) and another Chang (張), the dancing floor managers
of the Vienna Dance Hall, for 25 dancing girls to take
part in the inauguration ceremony of the Shanghai Special
City Government. For this the two managers of the Vienna
Dance Hall were each given a reward of $250, while the
25 girls were given $40 each.
According to a certain person who
attended the ceremony of Fu's assumption of office, the
ceremony took place in the auditorium of the former
Shanghai City Government Buildings at which there were
present Liang Hung-tse (梁鴻志), Wen Chung-yao (溫宗堯)
and other puppet officials of the "Reformed Government"
as well as Japanese officials.
The Shanghai Special City Government
has its offices in the premises of the Municipal Library
of the former Shanghai City Government.
According to information secured from
reliable sources by the Hsien Tai News Agency (現代通訊社),
in addition to the appointments that were made known
yesterday, Yang Kyung-ping (楊景誠), a returned student
from America, at present member of the Legislative Yuan
of the "Reformed Government," has been appointed Director
of the Foreign Affairs Department on the recommendation
of Chen Chung-fu (陳中孚); Li Ting-shih (李定士),
ex-Manager of the Wei Ming Milk Company (惠民牛奶公司) and
at one time Chairman of the Nantao Maintenance Association,
has been appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of
Communications, and Yang Siao-daung (楊小棠), a
departmental chief of the Land Bureau of the former
Shanghai City Government, has been appointed Commissioner
of the Land Bureau, of the Shanghai Special City
Government.
The action of Fu Siao-en has aroused
much indignation amongst the members of the Ningpo Fellow
Countrymen's Association. A joint petition is said to
have been submitted to the authorities in Ningpo
yesterday by Chen Ching-ming (陳景明) and other members
of the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, demanding
the confiscation of the entire property of the traitor
in Chinhai (鎮海).
The petition reads as follows:-
pages.zh:
副督察长（特别支部）

1938年10月18日。下午译文。

《华美晨报》：

宁波居民与傅筱庵

傅筱庵（傅筱庵）于10月16日就任上海特别市政府市长一职，是一场荒谬的闹剧。例如，在他就职当天，为了赢得日本人的信任并展示其影响力，他从维也纳舞厅（維也納）找来25名舞女，向日本人介绍她们是上海的知名女孩和女士。据说，这是由其养子徐（徐）代为操办的，他代表傅联系了维也纳舞厅的两位舞池经理赵（趙）和张（張），找来25名舞女参加上海特别市政府的就职典礼。为此，维也纳舞厅的两位经理各获得250元酬金，而25名舞女每人获得40元。
据一位出席傅就职典礼的人士称，典礼在原上海市政府大楼的礼堂举行，出席者包括梁鸿志（梁鴻志）、温宗尧（溫宗堯）等“维新政府”的傀儡官员以及日本官员。
上海特别市政府的办公地点设在原上海市政府市立图书馆的房屋内。
据现代通讯社（現代通訊社）从可靠来源获得的消息，除了昨天公布的任命外，留美学生、现任“维新政府”立法院委员杨景诚（楊景誠），经陈中孚（陳中孚）推荐，被任命为外交部局长；前惠民牛奶公司（惠民牛奶公司）经理、曾任南市维持会会长的李定士（李定士），被任命为交通局局长；原上海市政府土地局科长杨小棠（楊小棠），被任命为上海特别市政府土地局局长。
傅筱庵的行为在宁波同乡会成员中引起了极大愤慨。据悉，宁波同乡会成员陈景明（陳景明）等人已于昨日向宁波当局提交联合请愿书，要求没收该汉奸在镇海（鎮海）的全部财产。
请愿书内容如下：-

pages.en:
October 18, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

"The traitor Fu Siao-en was formerly a
for men in the Ziang Sung Iron Works (洋生铁厂) in
Portung. Later he joined the China Merchants' Steam
Navigation Company as a junior employee and won the
confidence of the late Mr. Sheng Kung-pao who promoted
him General Manager of the China Merchants' Steam
Navigation Company and of the Commercial Bank of China.
He was also at one time Chairman of the Chamber of
Commerce. For his conspiracy with the late Marshal Sun
Chuen-feng (孙传芳) at the time of the northern
expedition of the revolutionary army, a circular order
for his arrest was issued by the National Government.
He escaped to Dairen where under the protection of the
Japanese, he was able to evade arrest. In the 23rd Year
(1934) of the Chinese Republic, he expressed his repentance
and through the efforts of certain influential persons,
the order for his arrest was withdrawn. He should have
been thankful to the Government for its leniency, but
instead of doing something to make good, he has now
become a traitor and assumed the post of Mayor of the
Shanghai Special City Government on October 16 under the
protection of the Japanese. His betrayal constitutes
a serious disgrace to his ancestors and to his fellow
provincials. We, therefore, submit you this petition
with a request that the Chinhai Hsien Government be
instructed to confiscate the entire property of this
traitor and contribute it to the war chest as a warning
against traitors."

It is rumoured that Fu Siao-en's son Fu
Ping-kwei (傅品圭) is planning to sever all connection
with his traitorous father. However, according to
information secured by a reporter of this paper, this
rumour is entirely groundless. Knowing full well that
his traitorous activities will have serious consequences
upon his sons and grandsons and fearing that his fellow
provincials might desecrate the graves of his ancestors
at his native place and with a view to preserving his
property, Fu Siao-en had purposely spread this rumour
in order to mislead the public.
According to information secured from
another source, Fu Ping-kwei, son of this traitor, is
in the habit of visiting a certain metal shop on Canton
Road.

Hwa Mei Chen Pao publishes the following article :-
"FOOCHOW ROAD"
Of late I have been walking aimlessly along
Foochow Road which was formerly known as the street of
prostitutes. One day a police patrol car stopped near
Chekiang Road and a number of Chinese policemen alighted
and "with their eyes wide open" pounced upon a rag picker
like "a cat on a rat" and took him to the car.
"What is the matter, my lord policemen?"
asked the man. "I have done nothing wrong."
"What is the matter? Why are you in such a
ragged state? This is not a place for you!"
Shortly afterwards a crowd gathered and I
was so pressed that I could hardly breathe.
pages.zh:
1938年10月18日。下午译文。

“汉奸傅筱庵曾是浦东洋生铁厂（洋生铁厂）的一名工头。后来他加入轮船招商局担任初级职员，并赢得了已故盛公保（音译）(Mr. Sheng Kung-pao) 的信任，后者提拔他为轮船招商局和中国商业银行的总经理。他还曾担任商会会长。因在北伐革命军时期与已故上将孙传芳（孙传芳）勾结，国民政府发布了通缉令。他逃往大连，在日本人的庇护下得以逃避逮捕。民国二十三年（1934年），他表示悔过，并通过某些有影响力人士的努力，撤销了对他的通缉令。他本应感激政府的宽恕，但他非但没有改过自新，反而沦为汉奸，并于10月16日在日本人的庇护下就任上海特别市政府市长。他的背叛行为使其祖先和同乡蒙受巨大耻辱。因此，我们呈递此请愿书，请求指令镇海县政府没收该汉奸的全部财产，并捐作军费，以警示汉奸。”

有谣言称，傅筱庵之子傅品圭（傅品圭）正计划与其汉奸父亲断绝一切关系。然而，根据本报记者获得的消息，这一谣言毫无根据。傅筱庵深知其汉奸活动将给其子孙带来严重后果，并担心同乡可能会在其家乡亵渎其祖坟，为了保全其财产，傅筱庵故意散布这一谣言以误导公众。
据另一来源的消息，该汉奸之子傅品圭习惯光顾广东路的一家金属店。

《华美晨报》刊登以下文章：
“福州路”
最近我一直在福州路上漫无目的地行走，这条路以前被称为妓女街。一天，一辆警车停在浙江路附近，几名中国警察下车，“睁大眼睛”，像“猫抓老鼠”一样扑向一名拾荒者，并将他带上车。
“警察老爷，怎么回事？”那人问道。“我没做错什么。”
“怎么回事？你为什么衣衫褴褛成这样？这里不是你待的地方！”
不久之后，人群聚集起来，我被挤得几乎无法呼吸。
